places.name: Terasa cu Ancore

places.name: Pensiunea Restaurant Dana
places.area: central Eforie Nord, ~200m from beach near Hotel Europa
places.evidence: Self-described 'afacere de familie' for 25 years; reviews praise the family running the place (Facebook, restaurantguru)

places.name: Jimmy's Corner

places.name: Cherhanaua Sailors
places.evidence: Proprietor Florin Burja named in local press; amfostacolo reviews describe the owner personally present on-site (positively and negatively)

places.name: Pizzeria/Restaurant La Famiglia
places.area: Bd. Tudor Vladimirescu 28, near Belona beach
places.evidence: Multi-generational family pizzeria continuing a 30-year family story on the same spot; grill cooked in front of customers
